title: Baking Workshop for Young Women
description:
One of my biggest dreams has always been to share the gift of baking with young people, especially young women who are looking for skills to build a better future.

This past month, I hosted a free baking workshop for 15 young women from underserved communities. Over the course of two days, they learned the fundamentals of baking - from measuring ingredients to decorating cakes.

We made cupcakes, cookies, and a simple vanilla cake together. But more than the recipes, they learned that baking can be a path to independence. Several participants expressed interest in starting their own small baking businesses.

Seeing their faces light up when they decorated their first cupcake - that is the kind of joy money cannot buy.

I provided all the ingredients, equipment, and each participant went home with a starter kit including a mixing bowl, spatula, measuring cups, and a recipe booklet.

This workshop is something I plan to continue doing regularly. If you know a young woman who would benefit from learning to bake, send them my way.
